text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on La Rose Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is recommending to prohibit parking at all times on the north side of La Rose Avenue, between a point 100 metres east of Timothy Court and a point 20 metres further east. A walkway connecting La Rose Avenue to Westmount Park is located within the area of the proposed parking prohibition.

City Council on November 9, 10 and 12, 2021, adopted the following: 1. City Council prohibit parking at all times on the north side of La Rose Avenue, between a point 100 metres east of Timothy Court and a point 20 metres further east.
